           FROM dcmon.execution_paths(now()) e(system_key, environment, component_key, target_key, server_key, server_id, node_ids)
          WHERE (c.ci_id = ANY (e.node_ids))))))

functions.comment: Validates INSERT/UPDATE targets for deployment, installation_placement and volume_attachment. A compute target is a physical server or any runtime; only deployment may additionally target software_installation. Raises SQLSTATE 23514 on a type mismatch; foreign keys separately require existence. Uses the caller search_path dcmon,public.

Checks directed consumer/provider types on dependency INSERT/UPDATE. Application: component to component/installation; power: device/rack to PDU/UPS/generator; cooling: room/rack/device to CRAC/chiller; network: device/runtime to switch; storage: device/runtime to storage. Rejects unknown/missing endpoint types with SQLSTATE 23514; does not infer availability, redundancy or traversal in the reverse direction. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

Checks hosting INSERT/UPDATE hierarchy: VM to physical server, pod to VM/server, container to pod. Rejects invalid or missing endpoint types with SQLSTATE 23514. Effective-dated overlap constraints separately prevent simultaneous hosts. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

On metric_sample INSERT/UPDATE, validates only quality=ok against its definition valid_min/valid_max. NULL bounds leave that side unrestricted. Table checks independently require finite values for ok and NULL for missing/error. Warning and critical thresholds are presentation guidance, never validity limits. Raises SQLSTATE 23514 for a range breach. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

On device_placement INSERT/UPDATE with a U interval, acquires a shared lock on the target rack and checks inclusive top U (u_start+u_height-1) against height_u. NULL U denotes floor/0U placement and bypasses the capacity test; table checks and exclusions enforce other shape/overlap rules. Raises SQLSTATE 23514 on overflow. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

On storage_volume INSERT/UPDATE, requires storage_device_id to identify a device of class storage. Rejects absent or other-class devices with SQLSTATE 23514. A foreign key alone cannot express the device-class requirement. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

functions.returns: TABLE(origin_id bigint, server_id bigint, node_ids bigint[])
functions.comment: Returns origin_id, terminal physical server_id and ordered node_ids for server/runtime/installation origins visible at p_at. Follows hosting and installation_placement intervals [valid_from,valid_to), excludes planned origins, respects origin first_seen_at/retired_at, and includes a physical server own one-node path. Rejects revisiting a path node and caps node count at 64. Multiple legitimate paths remain separate; downstream selection deduplicates hosts. Does not reconstruct historical software versions.

functions.returns: TABLE(system_key text, environment text, component_key text, target_key text, server_key text, server_id bigint, node_ids bigint[])
functions.comment: Returns application-to-server execution paths at p_at: component root, first target, ordered node_ids and system/environment keys. Traverses effective deployment, directed application dependencies, installation placement and guest-to-host hosting using half-open intervals. The visited-node guard prevents cycles and the 64-node cap bounds recursion. Emits each path ending at a physical server; does not deduplicate paths or apply CI lifecycle visibility independently of relationship intervals.

Before ci kind updates, rejects a different subtype with SQLSTATE 23514 so existing subtype, topology and telemetry references retain their interpretation. Other inventory attributes may change. Retiring/replacing a CI preserves identity history instead of retyping it.

Before device_class updates, rejects a different class with SQLSTATE 23514 because dependency and hosting rules rely on that class. Replace or retire an incorrectly classified device through an explicit migration rather than silently reinterpreting relationships.
Before runtime_kind updates, rejects changing VM/pod/container type with SQLSTATE 23514 because hosting rules depend on the subtype. A newly created workload instance requires its own identity.

Returns true if p_id is a physical device of class server or a runtime; false for missing IDs and other physical equipment. It is a type predicate, not a lifecycle, health, placement or capacity test. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

functions.returns: TABLE(series_id bigint, ci_id bigint, object_key text, metric_code text, unit text, labels jsonb, observed_at timestamp with time zone, raw_value numeric, display_value numeric, freshness text, age_seconds numeric)
functions.comment: For every metric_series, selects the latest sample with observed_at<=p_at, independent of ingestion time. Returns raw_value for diagnosis and display_value only when quality=ok and observation age is <=stale_after_sec. No point yields missing; age strictly above the budget yields stale before checking point quality; otherwise quality missing/error propagates, or ok becomes fresh. Age is in seconds and no value or timestamp is fabricated. Does not filter series by CI lifecycle or first_seen_at; labels/definitions are current inventory attributes.

Before rack height updates, rejects any height below the inclusive top U of an existing placement, including historical/closed intervals. Preserves historical physical validity; it is intentionally stricter than checking only current placements. Raises SQLSTATE 23514. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

On subtype INSERT/UPDATE, compares NEW.ci_id to the expected dcmon.ci.kind supplied in the trigger argument. Rejects both missing CIs and mismatches with SQLSTATE 23514; foreign keys separately maintain ownership. Does not require every CI to have a subtype row. Uses caller search_path dcmon,public.

functions.returns: TABLE(ci_id bigint, object_key text, state text, reason text, observed_at timestamp with time zone)
functions.comment: For each CI with first_seen_at<=p_at and no retirement at/before p_at, selects its latest status_observation with observed_at<=p_at. No observation or age strictly greater than valid_for_sec becomes unknown, with an English reason; equality remains fresh. Preserves the source timestamp for stale diagnostics. Does not exclude planned lifecycle CIs or infer status from incidents/metrics.

functions.args: p_system_key text, p_environment text, p_software_code text, p_at timestamp with time zone
functions.returns: TABLE(server_id bigint, server_key text, server_name text, rack_key text, room_key text, site_key text)
functions.comment: Returns distinct physical servers selected by optional system key, environment and software product code at p_at; NULL means no restriction. Uses execution_paths and, only with both system/environment NULL, compute_paths to retain unmapped hosts. Software must be on the selected path or installed on a node of that path, avoiding sibling VM leakage. Current effective device placement supplies optional rack/room/site keys; unplaced hosts remain with NULL location. Does not test historical software version.

functions.args: p_system_key text, p_environment text, p_at timestamp with time zone
functions.returns: TABLE(incident_key text, title text, severity text, state text, detected_at timestamp with time zone, matched_objects bigint, interpretation text)
functions.comment: Returns one row per incident in system_scope at p_at with detection and incident-CI link times not after p_at. Latest workflow event determines state; resolved/closed incidents are excluded. matched_objects counts distinct in-scope linked CIs and all impact_role values may match, so potential risk is not a confirmed application outage. Multiple links do not multiply incidents. Interpretation remains explicitly advisory.

functions.args: p_system_key text, p_environment text, p_at timestamp with time zone
functions.comment: Builds CI scope for optional system/environment at p_at from execution-path nodes, matching components and systems, effective physical locations, software installed on core nodes, attached volumes and containing clusters. With both filters NULL it also seeds historically visible CIs. Recurses only consumer-to-provider through non-application infrastructure dependencies; UNION deduplicates nodes and terminates cycles. Never traverses reverse hosting to sibling VMs. Location/attachment expansion uses the core set, not every later infrastructure node; the function does not infer transitive impact severity.

functions.args: p_system_key text, p_environment text, p_at timestamp with time zone
functions.returns: TABLE(system_key text, environment text, server_key text, installation_key text, product_code text, category text, version text, association text)
functions.comment: Returns distinct software installations placed on nodes of selected execution paths at p_at with optional system/environment filters (NULL is unrestricted). association=explicit_dependency means the installation itself is a path node; otherwise installed_on_execution_path means presence on a path host, not proof of use. Only placement is effective-dated: version, product and instance inventory remain current attributes. Unmapped compute is not added by this function.
